_note: Fictional bank. Harbour & Vale Bank does not exist. All names, numbers and people in this project are invented.
name: Harbour & Vale Bank
type: UK retail bank (fictional), about 1.2 million personal customers

causes.label: Unauthorised transaction (customer says they did not make it)
Payment delayed, failed or wrongly executed
Bereavement or power of attorney process

teams.label: Frontline complaints
teams.remit: Straightforward complaints the first handler can resolve, including summary resolution within three business days.

teams.label: Fraud and Scams
teams.remit: Scams where the customer authorised the payment, and unauthorised transactions.

teams.label: Bereavement and Power of Attorney
teams.remit: Deceased customers' accounts, executors, powers of attorney and third-party authority.

teams.label: Financial Support
teams.remit: Arrears, collections, affordability and lending decisions on cards, loans and overdrafts.

teams.label: Mortgage Servicing
teams.remit: Mortgage rates, product switches, redemptions and mortgage arrears.

teams.label: Payments and Disputes
teams.remit: Failed, delayed or wrongly executed payments, Direct Debit claims and card disputes (chargebacks).

teams.label: Ombudsman Liaison
teams.remit: Complaints the customer has already referred to the Financial Ombudsman Service (policy CP-3.5).

case_systems.label: Customer relationship system (complaint log and call notes)
